description: This file contains handler implementations for managing in-memory data within a web server context, including operations to set, get, delete, and list memory entries, as well as definitions for associated request and response structures.

methods.name: SetMemoryHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to set a memory value, which updates the storage and publishes an event.

methods.name: GetMemoryHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to retrieve a memory value, searching across multiple scopes if not explicitly specified.

methods.name: DeleteMemoryHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to delete a memory value and publish a delete event.

methods.name: ListMemoryHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to list memory entries within a specified scope.

methods.name: resolveScope
methods.description: Determines the scope and scope ID for memory operations based on context headers or explicit parameter.

methods.name: getScopeID
methods.description: Retrieves scope-specific ID from request headers.
